prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reports immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are consistent with the reported symptoms. Two office visits were completed. Examination documented cervical paraspinal muscle tenderness, muscle spasm, and restricted rotation and flexion. Imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury, with no fracture or dislocation identified. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this type, and the plan included continued home exercise and anti-inflammatory medication. The patient also has a history of treatment to the same cervical region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing for the encounters reflects single charges per service, with no duplicate billing noted. Diagnosis: cervical strain, acute, secondary to motor vehicle collision. Prognosis is fair with conservative management.
